# Issue tracking

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26.
     Canonical spec: ~/code/claude-template.md Appendix B. -->

This repo tracks work in **files**: `docs/issues/NNN-<slug>.md`, three-digit sequential. The
short number is what makes an issue citable in ADRs, commit messages and chat.

## 1. The split from the ledger (**never write the same prose in both**)

| | Here (`docs/issues/`) | The vault ledger (`20-Projects/Active/d2r-mobile.md`) |
|---|---|---|
| Holds | **Concrete defects / work items**: repro steps, verifiable criteria | Status / milestones / progress log / next steps |
| Grain | One issue = one closable unit | A one-screen dashboard |
| Who orders it | The ledger's "next steps" ordering | The ledger |

When does a ledger "next step" graduate into an issue: **when it starts needing repro steps and
verifiable criteria**. At that moment: create the file + the index row, write "from ledger next
steps, <date>" under `Context`, and **rewrite the ledger line into a one-line pointer** that
keeps the marker — never keep two copies of the same prose.

## 2. Lifecycle

```
open → in-progress → closed-verified (<date>)
                   ↘ ⏸ DEFERRED (<date>) → <where the decision lives>
```

- `closed-verified` means **the criteria were re-run**, not "it merged". Merged ≠ accepted.
- An issue deferred by decision: the rationale is consolidated into an ADR, the issue is marked
  historical, and its body is not deleted.
- An issue is an append-mostly work log: check items off, add dated status lines, **do not
  rewrite history**.

## 3. Format

See [`0000-template.md`](0000-template.md). Required: `Status:` (with a date) · `Severity:` ·
`Labels:` · `Size:` (task / epic / huge epic) · `Context:` · `## Items` · `## Exit`.
**An issue with no `## Exit` is `needs-info`** — criteria must be mechanically checkable
("conformance scenario X is green", "p99 < N ms"), not vibes.

python3 tools/dev/check_docs.py --only index
